meta.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64 100% definition)
meta.subtitle: Switch 2 remake — midnight-launch one-sitting 100% binge route
meta.scope: Single-playthrough, glitchless, missable-safe linear route to community 100%: 36 Heart Pieces, 100 Gold Skulltulas, 12 songs, all equipment / items / capacity upgrades, 4 bottles, both trade sequences (Biggoron's Sword + Happy Mask), all 6 Great Fairy upgrades, 3 Spiritual Stones, 6 Medallions, and every dungeon.
meta.confidencePolicy: Hardened pass: all 36 Heart Pieces now carry exact locations/methods (Thonky checklist) and per-area Gold Skulltula COUNTS are sourced and sum to 100. Per-token Skulltula spots are still grouped as area tallies — trust the in-game Gold Skulltula count as source of truth. Re-check on launch night whether the remake adds/moves anything (this baseline is original N64).
meta.remakeNote: Built pre-release on the original N64 100% baseline. Patch in remake-specific changes on launch night.
meta.sources: Heart Pieces: thonky.com/ocarina-of-time/pieces-of-heart (36 total). Gold Skulltula area counts: thonky.com + zeldadungeon + jegged cross-check (100 total).

confidenceLegend.high: Cross-confirmed, fixed in the original game (now incl. all Heart Pieces + Skulltula area counts).
confidenceLegend.verify: Exact per-token Skulltula spot within an area — confirm in-game via the Gold Skulltula count.

phases.title: Kokiri Forest & Inside the Deku Tree
phases.blurb: The opening. Grab the basics, clear the first dungeon, earn the first Spiritual Stone.

steps.title: Get the Kokiri Sword
steps.loc: Kokiri Forest (training-path hole behind the fence)
steps.do: Crawl the maze behind the boulder to the chest.

steps.title: Buy a Deku Shield
steps.do: Cut grass / break pots for rupees first.

steps.title: Inside the Deku Tree — Fairy Slingshot
steps.do: Main dungeon item.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Inside the Deku Tree
steps.do: 3 tokens: on webs/vines through the dungeon (child-only — get them now).

steps.title: Defeat Queen Gohma — Kokiri's Emerald
steps.do: First Spiritual Stone; clears the dungeon (boss Heart Container).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Kokiri Forest
steps.do: 3 tokens (some need night; one near the Know-It-All house, one behind Mido's house, one on the training-area wall).

phases.title: Lost Woods, Saria's Song & forest Heart Pieces
phases.blurb: Saria's Song, two Skull Kid Heart Pieces, and the Deku Theater mask rewards (come back once you have the masks).

steps.title: Learn Saria's Song
steps.do: Navigate the Lost Woods correct-exit sequence to the Meadow.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Lost Woods (Skull Kids)
steps.do: #3: right one screen, drop down, play the song-matching game with the two Skull Kids 3× (gets harder). #4: left one screen, stand on the stump and play Saria's Song for the lone Skull Kid.

items.label: HP #3 — Lost Woods (Skull Kids song game ×3)
HP #4 — Lost Woods (Saria's Song for Skull Kid on stump)

steps.title: Deku Theater rewards (return with masks)
steps.do: Show the Skull Mask → Deku Stick capacity; later the Mask of Truth → Deku Nut capacity. (Needs the mask trade — flagged so you don't forget to come back.)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Lost Woods & Sacred Forest Meadow
steps.do: 4 tokens: 3 in the Lost Woods (one is adult-only via the bridge) + 1 in Sacred Forest Meadow (adult-only).

phases.title: Hyrule Field & Lon Lon Ranch
phases.blurb: Epona's Song, the Lon Lon silo Heart Piece, and a Hyrule Field grotto Heart Piece.

steps.title: Learn Epona's Song
steps.do: Talk to Malon by the corral with the Fairy Ocarina.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Lon Lon & Hyrule Field
steps.do: #2: in the silo, pull the crate and crawl through the hole. #15: bomb the hole in the field near Lake Hylia, then buy the HP from the Business Scrub in the grotto.

items.label: HP #2 — Lon Lon Ranch silo (pull crate, crawl through)
HP #15 — Hyrule Field grotto (bomb hole near Lake Hylia, buy from Scrub)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Hyrule Field
steps.do: 2 tokens in field grottos (open via bomb / Song of Storms).

phases.title: Castle Town, Hyrule Castle & Zelda
phases.blurb: Zelda's Lullaby, the start of the Happy Mask trade chain, two Market Heart Pieces, and the Din's Fire Great Fairy.

steps.title: Start the Happy Mask trade (Weird Egg)
steps.do: Get the Weird Egg → hatches into a Cucco → wakes Talon. Trade chain begins.

steps.title: Learn Zelda's Lullaby
steps.loc: Hyrule Castle courtyard (Impa, after meeting Zelda)
steps.do: Sneak past guards to the courtyard.

steps.title: Deliver Zelda's Letter → run the mask chain
steps.do: Letter to Talon, then borrow masks from the Happy Mask Shop and sell them in order: Keaton → Spooky → Skull → Bunny Hood → Mask of Truth.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Market
steps.do: #1: at night, follow the white dog to the woman in the back alley. #14: win the Bombchu Bowling prize (alley shop — needs bombs/rupees, may take retries). #27: win the Treasure Chest Game using the Lens of Truth (grab Lens in the Well first).

items.label: HP #1 — Market alley (follow white dog at night)
HP #27 — Treasure Chest Game (with Lens of Truth)

steps.title: Great Fairy — Din's Fire
steps.loc: Hyrule Castle grotto (bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Magic spell from the Great Fairy.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Market & path to Castle
steps.do: 2 tokens (child): 1 in Castle Town Market, 1 on the path/vines to Hyrule Castle.

phases.title: Kakariko Village, Graveyard & Bottom of the Well
phases.blurb: Sun's Song, the Cucco bottle, Hylian Shield, three Heart Pieces, and the child-only Bottom of the Well (Lens of Truth).

steps.title: Bottle #1 — Cucco Lady
steps.do: Round up the 7 escaped cuccos → empty Bottle.

steps.title: Learn Sun's Song
steps.loc: Graveyard (Royal Family's Tomb / Composer Brothers' grave)
steps.do: Pull the grave, read the song.

steps.title: Free Hylian Shield
steps.do: Pull the grave at the back row for a chest containing the Hylian Shield.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Kakariko & Graveyard (child)
steps.do: #5: in the Graveyard, play Sun's Song on the ReDead grave, pull it, play again for the chest. #6: complete Dampé's gravedigging tour (night). #9: reach the cucco-pen roof (via the owl, or Hookshot as adult).

items.label: HP #5 — Graveyard (Sun's Song ReDead grave chest)

steps.title: Bottom of the Well — Lens of Truth
steps.loc: Kakariko well (drain via Song of Storms in the windmill)
steps.do: Child-only dungeon. Get the Lens of Truth (mandatory for Shadow Temple & many secrets).

steps.title: Learn Song of Storms
steps.do: The windmill man teaches it.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Bottom of the Well
steps.do: 3 tokens (child-only).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Kakariko & Graveyard
steps.do: 8 tokens: 6 in Kakariko Village (mixed child/adult — soft soil, walls, House of Skulltula) + 2 in the Graveyard (child).

steps.title: Wallet upgrades & 50-GS Heart Piece (Skulltula House)
steps.do: Adult's Wallet at 10 tokens, Giant's Wallet at 30, and Heart Piece #23 at 50.

phases.title: Death Mountain Trail, Goron City & Crater
phases.blurb: Goron's Bracelet, the Magic Meter Great Fairy, the Bomb Bag, and two Death Mountain Heart Pieces.

steps.title: Great Fairy — Magic Meter
steps.loc: Death Mountain Trail (top, bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Grants the magic bar.

steps.title: Goron's Bracelet & Bomb Bag
steps.do: Goron's Bracelet from Darunia (play Saria's Song); Bomb Bag from the rolling Goron minigame.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Death Mountain (child)
steps.do: #7: in Goron City, light the torches then throw a bomb into the spinning jar. #8: above the cavern entrance on DM Trail — backflip onto the ledge (or ride a Magic Bean as adult).

items.label: HP #7 — Goron City (torches + bomb in spinning jar)
HP #8 — DM Trail (backflip above cavern / Magic Bean)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Death Mountain & Goron City
steps.do: 9 tokens: DM Trail 3 + DM Crater 2 + Goron City 2 + 2 more on Death Mountain reachable adult/night.

steps.title: Defeat King Dodongo — Goron's Ruby
steps.do: Bomb Bag required; earns the Goron's Ruby (boss Heart Container).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Dodongo's Cavern
steps.do: 5 tokens (3 reachable as child, 2 need adult — you can return).

phases.title: Zora's River, Domain, Fountain & Jabu-Jabu
phases.blurb: Magic Beans (plant them ALL now), the Silver Scale, the Ruto's-Letter bottle, Farore's Wind, five Zora-area Heart Pieces, then the third dungeon and final Spiritual Stone.

steps.title: Buy & plant all Magic Beans
steps.do: Plant a bean at every soft-soil spot now — they grow into adult platforms for several Heart Pieces (Lake Hylia, DM Trail/Crater, Graveyard, Desert Colossus). Buying the full set counts toward 100%.
steps.missableNote: Plant beans as a CHILD or the adult Heart Pieces that ride them won't be reachable on this run.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Zora's River & Domain
steps.do: #10: ride a Cucco to the pillar ledge. #11: Cucco/Hover Boots near the waterfall. #12: in King Zora's room light a Deku Stick and light the torches. #29: play Song of Storms for the music-loving frogs. #30: win the frogs' bug-catching game after playing all their songs.

items.label: HP #10 — Zora's River (Cucco to pillar ledge)
HP #29 — Zora's River frogs (Song of Storms)

steps.title: Silver Scale (diving game)
steps.do: Win King Zora's diving minigame for the Silver Scale (deeper diving).

steps.title: Bottle #2 — Ruto's Letter
steps.do: After delivering the letter the bottle is yours, empty.

steps.title: Great Fairy — Farore's Wind
steps.loc: Zora's Fountain (bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Warp/recall spell.

steps.title: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly — Zora's Sapphire
steps.do: Boomerang dungeon; third Spiritual Stone (boss Heart Container).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Zora areas & Jabu-Jabu
steps.do: 12 tokens: River 4 + Domain 1 (adult) + Fountain 3 + Jabu-Jabu 4 (child-only).

phases.title: Song of Time & the Master Sword
phases.blurb: Last child-only sweep, then pull the Master Sword and jump 7 years forward.

steps.title: Learn the Song of Time / get the Ocarina of Time
steps.do: With all 3 Spiritual Stones + Ocarina of Time, open the Door of Time.

steps.title: FINAL child-only cleanup before pulling the sword
steps.do: Confirm: child-only Gold Skulltulas (Deku Tree, Jabu-Jabu, Bottom of the Well, Kokiri/Kakariko soft soil), all beans planted, child Heart Pieces (#12 Zora's Domain, frog HPs). A few collectibles are far easier — or only possible — as a child.
steps.missableNote: Jabu-Jabu, Bottom of the Well and several soft-soil Skulltulas are child-only. Sweep before time-travelling.

steps.title: Pull the Master Sword → become adult
steps.do: You can travel between eras freely from here on by replacing the sword.

phases.title: Adult: Rauru, Prelude of Light & the Hookshot
phases.blurb: The adult era opens. Light Medallion, warp song home base, the Hookshot, and the Dampé-race Heart Piece.

steps.title: Light Medallion (Rauru)
steps.loc: Chamber of Sages (automatic on becoming adult)
steps.do: Rauru awards the Light Medallion when you first awaken as an adult.

steps.title: Learn Prelude of Light
steps.do: Warp to the Temple of Time.

steps.title: Get the Hookshot (+ Dampé-race Heart Piece)
steps.do: Race Dampé's ghost → Hookshot. #34: beat the race in under a minute (Longshot helps on a repeat run) for the Heart Piece.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — adult-only town / ranch / ruins
steps.loc: Lon Lon Ranch / Market ruins / Castle
steps.do: 5 tokens: Lon Lon Ranch 4 + 1 in the ruined Market / Castle area (adult).

phases.title: Sacred Forest Meadow & Forest Temple
phases.blurb: Minuet of Forest, the Fairy Bow, and the first Medallion.

steps.title: Learn Minuet of Forest
steps.do: Warp song to the Meadow.

steps.title: Forest Temple — Fairy Bow
steps.do: Main dungeon item (base Quiver = 30 arrows).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Forest Temple
steps.do: 5 tokens (adult-only).

phases.title: Death Mountain Crater & Fire Temple
phases.blurb: Bolero of Fire, Goron Tunic, the Megaton Hammer, Double Magic, two DM Crater Heart Pieces, and the Fire Medallion.

steps.title: Learn Bolero of Fire
steps.do: Warp song; grab the Goron Tunic first to survive the heat.

steps.title: Goron Tunic
steps.loc: Goron City (buy / Link the Goron kid)
steps.do: Heat-proof tunic (also free from Darunia's son).

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Death Mountain Crater
steps.do: #24: climb down the wall in the alcove. #36: ride the bean sprout (planted as a child) to the top of the smoking pillar.

items.label: HP #24 — DM Crater (climb down wall in alcove)
HP #36 — DM Crater (ride bean to smoking pillar top)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Fire Temple
steps.do: 5 tokens (adult-only).

phases.title: Ice Cavern, Lake Hylia, Zora's Fountain & Water Temple
phases.blurb: Iron Boots & Zora Tunic, Serenade of Water, the Golden Scale, six Heart Pieces around the water regions, Longshot, and the Water Medallion.

steps.title: Ice Cavern — Iron Boots, Zora Tunic & Heart Piece
steps.do: Mini-dungeon. #20: the red-ice Heart Piece in the icicle room. Iron Boots (needed in the Water Temple); King Zora gives the Zora Tunic once thawed.

items.label: HP #20 — Ice Cavern (red ice in icicle room)

steps.title: Golden Scale & fishing Heart Piece
steps.do: #13: catch the biggest fish at the pond for a Heart Piece; the record fish also earns the Golden Scale.

items.label: HP #13 — Fishing Pond (catch the biggest fish)

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Lake Hylia & Zora's Fountain
steps.do: #31: dive with the Golden Scale in the Lakeside Laboratory. #22: reach the lab roof via a grown bean or the Scarecrow's Song. #19: collect from the floating ice block in Zora's Fountain. #21: with Zora Tunic + Iron Boots, sink to the bottom of Zora's Fountain. #28: west of Market, bomb the lone tree, then use Golden Scale / Iron Boots underwater.

items.label: HP #31 — Lake Hylia (dive w/ Golden Scale in lab)
HP #22 — Lake Hylia (lab roof via bean/Scarecrow)
HP #21 — Zora's Fountain (sink w/ Zora Tunic + Iron Boots)
HP #28 — West of Market (bomb tree, dive w/ Golden Scale/Iron Boots)

steps.title: Water Temple — Longshot
steps.do: Upgrades the Hookshot.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Ice Cavern
steps.do: 3 tokens (adult-only).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Water Temple & Lake Hylia
steps.do: 10 tokens: Water Temple 5 (adult) + Lake Hylia 5 (mixed).

phases.title: Nocturne of Shadow & Shadow Temple
phases.blurb: Hover Boots, Nocturne of Shadow, three adult Kakariko/Graveyard Heart Pieces, and the Shadow Medallion. Bring the Lens of Truth.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Kakariko & Graveyard (adult)
steps.do: #17: in the Graveyard, ride the bean stalk and roll-attack the crate. #18: navigate Dampé's maze (Hookshot) to the windmill platform. #35: use the Longshot near the windmill.

items.label: HP #17 — Graveyard (ride bean stalk, roll crate)
HP #18 — Kakariko (Dampé's maze to windmill platform)

steps.title: Shadow Temple — Hover Boots
steps.do: Hover Boots are the dungeon item.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Shadow Temple
steps.do: 5 tokens (adult-only).

phases.title: Gerudo Valley, Fortress, Wasteland & Spirit Temple
phases.blurb: Gerudo card + horseback archery, five Gerudo-region Heart Pieces, Requiem of Spirit, Nayru's Love, Mirror Shield, Silver Gauntlets (child), and the Spirit Medallion.

steps.title: Free the carpenters → Gerudo Membership Card
steps.do: Free the 4 carpenters; the card opens the Training Ground & Wasteland.

steps.title: Horseback Archery → Heart Piece + Quiver
steps.do: #25: 1000+ points → Heart Piece. 1500 points → the 50-arrow Quiver.

steps.title: Heart Pieces — Gerudo Valley, Fortress & Colossus
steps.do: #16: behind the waterfall (Cucco as child, or drop to the ledge). #26: rooftop chest in the Fortress (Longshot / Scarecrow's Song). #32: distant crate in Gerudo Valley (Cucco / Longshot). #33: Desert Colossus — ride a grown bean to the top of the rock arch.

items.label: HP #33 — Desert Colossus (bean to rock-arch top)

steps.title: Learn Requiem of Spirit
steps.do: Cross the Haunted Wasteland (Lens of Truth + flags) to the Colossus.

steps.title: Spirit Temple (child half) — Silver Gauntlets
steps.do: Enter as CHILD via Requiem; the child half grants the Silver Gauntlets.

steps.title: Spirit Temple (adult half) — Mirror Shield
steps.do: Return as ADULT; the Mirror Shield is the adult-half item.

steps.title: Gerudo Training Ground (Ice Arrows)
steps.do: Optional vault of chests — the Ice Arrows live here, plus rupees/keys. (No Gold Skulltulas inside.)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Gerudo region & Spirit Temple
steps.loc: Gerudo Valley / Fortress / Wasteland / Colossus / Spirit
steps.do: 15 tokens: Gerudo Valley 4 + Fortress 2 + Haunted Wasteland 1 + Desert Colossus 3 + Spirit Temple 5.

phases.title: Biggoron's Sword & the last two bottles
phases.blurb: The timed Biggoron trade, the Big Poe and Lon Lon bottles, and the remaining spells/arrows.

steps.title: Biggoron's Sword trade chain (TIMED)
steps.loc: Kakariko → Lost Woods → DM → Lake → Zora → back
steps.do: Pocket Egg → Cojiro → Odd Mushroom → Odd Potion → Poacher's Saw → Broken Goron's Sword → Prescription → Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → Claim Check. Several legs are on a clock.
steps.missableNote: Odd Mushroom and Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → World's Finest are timed; deliver fast or redo that leg.

steps.title: Bottle #3 — Big Poe
steps.loc: Hyrule Field (on Epona, night) → Ghost Shop (Market)
steps.do: Catch a Big Poe and sell it at the Ghost Shop → empty Bottle.

steps.title: Bottle #4 — Lon Lon Super Cucco game
steps.loc: Lon Lon Ranch (wake Talon, play the cucco game)
steps.do: Find the 3 special cuccos in time → Bottle (with Lon Lon Milk).

steps.title: Remaining spells & arrows
steps.do: Confirm Din's Fire / Farore's Wind / Nayru's Love, plus Fire Arrows (Lake Hylia — shoot the rising sun from the island) and Ice Arrows (Training Ground). Light Arrows come from Zelda before Ganon's Castle.

steps.title: Capacity upgrades (Bullet Bag & Bomb Bag)
steps.loc: Market shooting gallery / Lost Woods scrub / Bombchu Bowling
steps.do: Bullet Bag upgrades (40 → 50 seeds) from the shooting galleries; Bomb Bag capacity upgrades (20 → 30 → 40) from the Goron and Bombchu Bowling prizes.

phases.title: Final audit, Ganon's Castle & the end
phases.blurb: Golden Gauntlets, Double Defense, Light Arrows, the 100-Skulltula reward, then finish.

steps.title: FINAL 100% audit before the point of no return
steps.do: Every meter should read full: Heart Pieces 36 (÷4 = 9 containers), Gold Skulltulas 100, all 12 songs, both swords + Biggoron, all 3 tunics / boots / shields, 4 bottles, both trade chains, 6 Great Fairies, 3 stones + 6 medallions, every dungeon.
steps.missableNote: Treat this as the wall — finish all collectibles before entering Ganon's Castle's final stretch.

steps.title: 100-Skulltula reward
steps.do: The cursed family is fully restored at 100 tokens (Huge Rupee). HP #23 at 50 was grabbed earlier.

steps.title: Ganon's Castle — Golden Gauntlets, Double Defense & Light Arrows
steps.do: Light Arrows from Zelda; the Spirit trial grants the Golden Gauntlets; the moat Great Fairy gives Double Defense.

steps.title: Gold Skulltula — Ganon's Castle
steps.do: 1 token reachable around the castle exterior.

steps.title: Defeat Ganondorf / Ganon — finish the game
steps.do: 100% in one sitting. GG.
